hook_text: A craft knife, a hot glue gun and twenty teenagers. Here is how a Technology room stays safe and the model still comes out right.
clip_script: Plan first: every step in order, parts before assembly, no glue until the dry fit works, and a test marked after every step that matters. Knife rules: hold it like a pen, cut along a steel rule towards you, fingers on top of the rule, light passes, cap it the second you put it down. Hot tools stay at their station; hot glue on skin goes under cold water, not wiped. Eyes covered when anything can snap. Then technique: mark out from the real-size numbers, check twice, score the folds, cut the outlines, slots from the corners in. Join for the force: long tabs for shear, a gusset for bending, something mechanical for pull-apart. Photograph every step and write every change. Changes are normal. Secret changes are the problem.
visual_style: Whiteboard checklist ticks down; a hand draws a knife along a rule with fingers highlighted on top; a glue gun sits on its stand; a net gets scored lines in blue and cut lines in red; a camera icon flashes at each step.
pacing: Plan, knife rules, hot rules, technique, record.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and write your team's making plan with a test after every key step.
